name: Alert when gold moves more than 2% in a day (MetalCharts API)

parameters.content:
## Alert when gold moves more than 2% in a day

Checks the gold spot price every 6 hours and posts a message to a webhook when the 24-hour change reaches 2% up or down. It alerts once per direction per day.

**Setup**
1. Get a free MetalCharts API key at https://metalcharts.org/metals-api
2. In **Get gold price**, create a **Header Auth** credential: Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer mc_live_...` (your key).
3. In **Send alert**, replace the URL with your Slack or Discord incoming webhook, or any URL that accepts a JSON POST. The body has `text` (Slack) and `content` (Discord).
4. Activate the workflow.

Change the threshold at the top of **Check the move**.

Every 6 hours is about 124 requests a month, inside the free plan's 200. On a paid plan, check hourly or every 15 minutes instead.

To send email, swap **Send alert** for a **Send Email** node and use `{{ $json.message }}` as the text.
